verdict.rationale: The Core API can list all DNS records for a domain and manage domain settings such as locks, so a user could script retrieval of some account data and prepare domains to move. There is no documented bulk or account-wide export in an open format (e.g., zone files or CSV), and the transfer documentation covers only transfers into name.com. missing for 10: documented full-account data export, open/standard export formats such as BIND zone files, documented transfer-out/auth-code retrieval flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving.
